payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in cue detection and scope resolution, including improvements in F1 scores and comparisons to earlier methods.

claims.text: Previously reported results in cue detection showed improvements of at least 0.29 F1 points and 4.27 F1 points in scope resolution.
Previous work on cue detection and scope resolution included a range of methods from rule-based systems to deep learning approaches.
State-of-the-art results were reported for negation scope resolution, with increases of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers dataset.
